title: The Legend of Korra Star Reacts to Surprise Reveal in Avatar: Seven Havens “Heartbreaking”
content: Avatar: Seven Havens revealed that Korra is blamed for the destruction of the world with its premiere episode, and the original voice star behind Korra revealed she felt “hurt” when finding that out.
author: ComicBook

title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Switch 2 Remake Game's Overview Trailer Reveals Hall of Fallen Foes
content: Nintendo began streaming on Wednesday an overview trailer for the Nintendo Switch 2 remake for the 1998 Nintendo 64 game The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time , and it reveals the new Hall of Fallen Foes, an area where players can view statues of enemies they have defeated.
author: ANN

title: Teenage Mercenary to Make Crunchyroll Anime Debut in 2027 With Big Studio Behind It – Watch First Trailer
content: Crunchyroll recently announced that it is going on an expedition to bring more manhwa anime adaptations to the industry. In the latest news, one of the most popular and diverse manhwa, Teenage Mercenary , has also been greenlit, with several details unveiled.
author: ComicBook

title: Heavily Armed High School Girls Project Gets Smartphone RPG
content: A website opened on Wednesday to announce a smartphone game for illustrator neco's Heavily Armed High School Girls ( Jū Heisōgata Joshi Kōsei ) project. NextNinja is developing the JJK: Jū Heisōgata Joshi Kōsei Wordless Record game.
author: ANN

title: CloverWorks' Anime Film Grotesqqque to Feature Mika Ichinose Song
content: The official website for Atsushi Nishigori 's original anime film Grotesqqque (previously titled Grotesque) confirmed on Wednesday that the film will feature the song "TERASE" sung by Mika Ichinose , one of the music contributors for the "A(E)liens" story.
author: ANN

title: Yumene Connect Gets Anime
content: Ko Sawada’s manga, Yumene Connect , is getting an anime adaptation. A teaser visual and trailer were also released along with the main staff and cast. Studio Massket is animating the series. Yu Sasahara and Yusuke Kobayashi star in the series as Nano and Yuhi Takamiya, respectively.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kou Sawada's Risque Comedy Manga Yumeneconnect Gets TV Anime
content: The cast members include: Yūsuke Kobayashi as Yūhi Takamiya Yū Sasahara as Nano Sōta Yokote ( To Your Eternity season 3) is directing the anime at Studio Massket . title: Manga 'Kimi to Koete Koi ni Naru' Ends Serialization
content: Chihiro Yuzuki 's Kimi to Koete Koi ni Naru ( With You, Our Love Will Make It Through ) manga ended its serialization on Wednesday. The 133th and final chapter marked the end of its five-year run.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Manga 'Yumene Connect' Gets TV Anime
content: Production company Shochiku opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Kou Sawada 's Yumene Connect manga on Wednesday, revealing the main cast, staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Apothecary Diaries Film's New Video Unveils Miyuki Sawashiro, Ai Mikami in Cast
content: TOHO animation began streaming a character promotional video for The Apothecary Diaries : The Late Lady's Treasure ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto: Bо̄hi no Hihо̄ ), the upcoming anime film based on Hyuganatsu and Touko Shino 's The Apothecary Diaries ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ) light novel series, on Wednesday.
author: ANN
